summary: Iteration 2 — tested all P1 features: refresh token, forgot/reset password, resume upload (Emergent objstore), and AI matching (Claude Sonnet). 34/34 pytest backend cases passed sequentially (19 regression + 15 new P1). Frontend Playwright flows for /forgot-password, /reset-password, /student AI Matches panel, /student/profile resume upload, /client/applicants AI ranking all pass. Only caveat: when run under pytest-xdist parallel mode, the reset-password test races with concurrent student-login calls (transient) — not a product bug; passes when run sequentially or in isolation.

minor.issue: P1 tests are not thread-safe against pytest-xdist parallel workers because they mutate the shared student's password. Consider annotating with pytest-xdist grouping (xdist_group) or running the reset-password test in a dedicated ephemeral user.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1240 lines — auth, files, AI, seed all in one file. Suggest splitting into modules (auth.py, files.py, ai.py, seed.py).
_ai_cache is an in-process dict — will not survive worker restarts and is not shared across replicas. Fine for demo, but move to Mongo/Redis for production.

/api/files/{id} accepts ANY valid access-token JWT to view files; no ACL check whether the requester is the owner or a client viewing a shortlisted applicant. Acceptable per the code comment ('recruiters need to view resumes'), but worth documenting/tightening later.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan.
CORS still uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True + allow_origin_regex='.*'; works via reflection but weakens same-origin credential intent.
seed_data writes /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every startup — could be gated by an idempotency flag.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral qa+*@test.com users; reset-password test resets & restores demo student password to Student@1234.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files now live under /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (iteration-1 regression, 19 cases) and test_p1.py (P1 additions, 15 cases). Run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -o addopts='' --junitxml=...` sequentially — the shared xdist workers race on demo-student password reset. AI-matching tests make real Claude Sonnet calls (~3–10s each) and cost credits. Frontend testids verified: forgot-form, forgot-email-input, forgot-submit-btn, forgot-dev-link, reset-form, reset-password-input, reset-confirm-input, reset-submit-btn, ai-run-btn, ai-matches-panel, ai-match-<id>, ai-rank-panel, ai-job-select (native <select>), ai-rank-btn, resume-upload-btn (empty state only), resume-current, resume-replace-btn, resume-file-input, login-forgot-link, login-demo-student, login-demo-client, logout-btn.
